name: io.github.asaraog/cricket-mcp
description: Cricket analytics for AI assistants: a calibrated win-probability model fitted on 17,907 matches, a ball-by-ball archive of 22,479 matches, career and batter-vs-bowler records, phase and venue analysis, live scores, and prediction-market prices.

environmentVariables.name: HISTORY_DB
environmentVariables.description: Where the ball-by-ball archive lives. Defaults to the OS cache directory; the archive downloads itself on first run.

environmentVariables.name: HISTORY_QUERY_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Deadline for archive queries (default 3s). Raise for heavy leaderboard aggregations.
